summary: Verified new Category-wise Commission & Refund feature end-to-end. 12/12 backend pytest cases pass (GET list, PUT upsert with 6 validation branches, bulk apply, non-admin forbidden, 404 unknown category, booking commission_config snapshot source=category with exact category rates). Admin UI: standalone sidebar menu 'Commission & Refund' present, /admin?tab=category_commission page renders stats, pending banner, search, filters, rows with status/edit testids, modal with 6 inputs, live totals, save disabled on invalid totals and enabled when both sum to 100, save persists and updates configured counts, Cancellation Reasons editor present. Integration Center no longer renders intg-card-commission while 25 other cards still render.

issues: Radix DialogContent missing Description/aria-describedby (a11y warning, non-blocking)

action_items: Optional: add DialogDescription or aria-describedby on CategoryCommissions cc-modal to silence a11y warning.
critical_code_review_comments: category_commission_service.resolve() correctly merges category rates onto global settings.commission block, falls back to source='global' when unconfigured — bookings cannot break.
booking_controller._build_booking snapshots ccfg['commission'] = resolve(settings, svc.category_id) at creation time, so later rate changes do not alter in-flight bookings.
Routes use require_role('admin'); non-admin requests return 403.
seed_data_creation: Configured 3 categories' rates via test flows (AC Repair, first two by bulk, Home Cleaning via UI). Idempotent upserts, no destructive data created.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Service areas restricted to Patna/Ranchi — use lat/lng 25.5941/85.1376 pincode 800001 city 'Patna' for booking tests. REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL via public URL ~5s latency; use timeout>=60. pytest.ini pins xdist loadscope -n 2; run serial with -n 0 (NOT -p no:xdist).
